evidence.fg_programming_user_exposed: primary-by-identity (user, 2026-11-08: the chip is the published RASP 3.0 design unchanged): the published infrastructure programs every FG individually to arbitrary targets and reads it back (Kim, Shah, Hasler, TVLSI 2017 programs single FG current sources over 6 decades); the routines ship in the Georgia Tech open toolset that Okika redistributes as a VM.
evidence.run_mode_local_write: primary-by-identity (same premise): on the published design injection happens only in PROGRAM mode -- the FG pFET drain is switched off the circuit onto the programming line and the array supply is raised above the run-mode rail to reach hot-electron-injection conditions; those switches belong to the programming infrastructure, not to any CAB signal. The chip's one published learning demo computes updates on the MSP430 and programs through that infrastructure (Shah & Hasler, JETCAS 2018). -> False. Corollary recorded for the write model: injection is the only per-cell mechanism (it RAISES pFET current); tunneling erase is global.
